Sandbox_MinidoracatSafehouse_CreateMode_:
Deed required: safehouses are created with a deed, and the deed tier sets the size.
Free: no deed needed; the size is limited by Free mode max side and Free mode max area.
Sandbox_MinidoracatSafehouse_ClaimsPerPl:
How many safehouses each player can have without paying. Admins can change it for one player in the admin panel.
Each safehouse after that needs a slot of its tier bought or rented in the Economy Center; without Minidoracat Economy, no more can be created.
Sandbox_MinidoracatSafehouse_FreeMaxSide: Longest side of a safehouse in free mode, in tiles.
Sandbox_MinidoracatSafehouse_FreeMaxArea: Largest area of a safehouse in free mode, in tiles. It never exceeds the max side squared.
Sandbox_MinidoracatSafehouse_ClaimGap_to:
Minimum number of tiles between safehouses of different players. Safehouses of the same owner can touch but not overlap.
Resource checks also look this many tiles beyond the area.
Sandbox_MinidoracatSafehouse_MaxShares_t: How many named players an owner can share one safehouse with.
Sandbox_MinidoracatSafehouse_AllowFactio: When enabled, owners can share a safehouse with their own faction.
Sandbox_MinidoracatSafehouse_LapseKeepDa: When a rental expires and a safehouse lapses, its area is kept for this many days and no one else can create a safehouse there. Renewing the rental restores it; after that, the area is released.
Sandbox_MinidoracatSafehouse_RedrawMinut:
For this many minutes after creation, the owner can redraw the area. No deed is used or returned.
0 turns redrawing off.
Sandbox_MinidoracatSafehouse_AvoidRoads_: A safehouse area cannot include roads.
Sandbox_MinidoracatSafehouse_RoadMargin_: No road may be within this many tiles outside the area either.
Sandbox_MinidoracatSafehouse_RoadKinds_t:
Separate with semicolons: main = main roads, street = streets and parking lots, gravel = gravel ground, sidewalk = sidewalks and plazas. Empty = main;street.
Within a few tiles of a home only main roads count, so players can enclose their own driveway.
Sandbox_MinidoracatSafehouse_AvoidResour:
A safehouse area cannot include resource buildings (police stations, hospitals and so on).
Needs Minidoracat MiniMap; without it, this is not checked.
Sandbox_MinidoracatSafehouse_ResourceRul:
MiniMap resources: matches the resource icons on the minimap.
Room data: a building counts if any room in it belongs to a chosen category. Also covers map mods; stricter.
Sandbox_MinidoracatSafehouse_ResourceCat:
Separate with semicolons. Category names are the same as in the minimap: military, police, gunstore, medical, pharmacy, fire, books, school, grocery, gas, tools, outdoor, prison, storage, electronics, church, farm, industry, retail, food.
Empty = military;police;gunstore;medical;pharmacy;fire;gas;prison (military, police, gun stores, medical, pharmacies, fire stations, gas stations, prisons).
Sandbox_MinidoracatSafehouse_TiersEnable: How many deed tiers are enabled, counting from tier 1. Deeds of disabled tiers cannot be used, do not drop and cannot be crafted.
Sandbox_MinidoracatSafehouse_Tier1Side_t: Longest side of a safehouse created with a tier 1 deed, in tiles.
Sandbox_MinidoracatSafehouse_Tier1Area_t: Largest area of a safehouse created with a tier 1 deed, in tiles. It never exceeds the max side squared.
Sandbox_MinidoracatSafehouse_Tier1PerPla:
How many tier 1 safehouses each player can have.
0 = no extra limit.

Sandbox_MinidoracatSafehouse_Tier1Free_t:
Tier 1 safehouses can take the player's free slots.
Turning this off does not affect existing safehouses.
Sandbox_MinidoracatSafehouse_Tier1Buy_to:
Players can buy tier 1 slots permanently in the Economy Center (needs Minidoracat Economy).
Slots already bought keep working when this is turned off.
Sandbox_MinidoracatSafehouse_Tier1Rent_t:
Players can rent tier 1 slots by the period in the Economy Center (needs Minidoracat Economy).
Rented slots keep renewing when this is turned off.
